entities.name: Courtney Hodges
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Courtney Hicks Hodges was a senior officer in the United States Army who commanded the First U.S. Army in the Western European Campaign of World War II. Hodges was a "mustang" officer, rising from private to
general.
